ValidationRule.description: You cannot close a Line if the associated client is a 'Prospect'. Closing a Line implies that the contract is signed and the client must be 'Onboarded' (or 'Active').
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Closed__c, "Won") ), OR( Client__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Subsidiary", Client__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Group" ), $Profile.Name != "Desktop Integration", $Profile.Name != "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.DMT_Line_God) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot close a Line if the associated client is a 'Prospect'. Closing a Line implies that the contract is signed and the client must be 'Onboarded' (or 'Active').
